moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Instance name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: What this instance is called where people see it: the name of the company or of the installation

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Default locale
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The language and formats shown for a person who has chosen none; a person's own locale wins

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Default time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The time zone times are shown in for a person who has chosen none; a person's own zone wins, and business dates keep their owners' meaning

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: New-device sign-in window (days)
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: A sign-in from a client not seen for this many days is reported to the account's owner as a new device

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Group recipient ceiling
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The most recipients one scheduled report or business alert rule may deliver to as a group; an organization's own cap is at most this

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Instance purpose
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Production, test or development: what the instance is run for
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set instance_purpose in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Server default locale
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The locale of a session with no user and no preference above
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set default_locale in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Server time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The zone the server reads a time with no zone in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set default_time_zone in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Database time zone
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The zone times are stored in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set before the first start; changing it later changes the meaning of stored times

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Public host name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The host name links in mail and redirects are made with
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_http_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: HTTPS links
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether links are made with https
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_https_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Largest upload (bytes)
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The largest request body the web server accepts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set webapp_max_upload in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Telemetry
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether traces, metrics and logs are kept for Monitor
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set telemetry_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Shortest password
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The fewest characters a new password may have
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set min-length on user-facade password in the runtime conf (System, Conf) and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Digits required
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The fewest digits a new password must hold
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set min-digits on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Other characters required
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The fewest characters that are neither letter nor digit a new password must hold
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set min-others on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Earlier passwords refused
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How many of an account's last passwords may not be chosen again
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set history-limit on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Weeks until a change is required
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: After this many weeks a sign-in asks for a new password
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set change-weeks on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Change required after a reset
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether a password sent by a reset must be changed at the next sign-in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set email-require-change on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Hours a reset stays usable
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long a password sent by a reset may be used
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set email-expire-hours on user-facade password in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Failed sign-ins before a lock
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: After this many wrong passwords in a row the account is locked for a time
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set max-failures on user-facade login in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Minutes a lock lasts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long an account stays locked after too many wrong passwords
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set disable-minutes on user-facade login in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Sign-in history kept
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether each sign-in leaves a history row, which Sessions and the new-device notice read
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set history-store on user-facade login in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Minutes until an idle session ends
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: A web session with no request for this long expires; 0 never
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set timeout on session-config of the webroot webapp in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Hours a browser stays signed in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long the sign-in a browser keeps between sessions lasts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set expire-hours on user-facade login-key in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Hours an app stays signed in
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: How long the sign-in of a desktop or mobile app lasts
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set device-expire-hours on user-facade login-key in the runtime conf and reload the conf

moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.title: Remote system
moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.description: A system that messages are sent to and received from (SystemMessageRemote)

moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.title: Mail sign-in provider
moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.description: The OAuth client mail accounts sign in with at a provider (EmailOAuthProvider)

moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.title: Network printer
moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.description: A printer on a print server (NetworkPrinter)

moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.title: Mail relay
moqui.server.ConnectionAdapter.description: An outgoing mail server no mail account owns (EmailServer)

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SMTP listener port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The port the listener for hosted and shared mail accounts binds; empty keeps it off
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set smtp_listen_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SMTP listener address
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The address the listener binds; this machine only by default
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set smtp_listen_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Gateway addresses allowed
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The addresses and ranges of the edge gateway, the only ones that may deliver; empty never starts the listener
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set smtp_allowed_addresses in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Gateway authentication name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The authserv-id of the gateway's Authentication-Results, the only ones kept; empty keeps them all as they came
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set smtp_authserv_id in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SMTP greeting name
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The name in the greeting and the Received field; the public host name when empty
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set smtp_hostname in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Mail taken from the internet
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether the listener takes mail from any sender and checks it itself, with no gateway in front
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set smtp_internet in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SMTP certificate file
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The certificate the listener offers for STARTTLS
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set smtp_tls_cert_file in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SSH port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The port of the built-in SSH server (SFTP, the terminal client, git over SSH); empty keeps it off
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set ssh_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SSH address
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The address the SSH server binds
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set ssh_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SSH public host
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The host clone URLs show; the public host name when empty
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set ssh_public_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SSH public port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The port clone URLs show; the SSH port when empty
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set ssh_public_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Git public URL
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The base of the clone URLs shown; made from the public host name when empty
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set git_public_url in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: XMPP domain
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The domain of the users' chat addresses; empty keeps XMPP off
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set xmpp_domain in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: XMPP port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The STARTTLS port for chat apps
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set xmpp_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: XMPP address
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The address the XMPP ports bind
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set xmpp_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: XMPP direct TLS port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The direct TLS port for chat apps
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set xmpp_tls_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Call media port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The UDP port of call media; empty keeps calls' media off
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set rtc_media_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Call media address
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The address call media binds
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set rtc_media_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Call media public address
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The address browsers are told, for a server behind address translation
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set rtc_public_address in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Call media TCP port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: A TCP port for browsers that cannot reach the UDP one
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set rtc_media_tcp_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: TURN port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The relay's UDP and TCP port; empty keeps it off
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set turn_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: TURN TLS port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The relay's TLS port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set turn_tls_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: TURN public host
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The name or address browsers are given for the relay
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set turn_public_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: External TURN servers
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: TURN servers run elsewhere that browsers are also given
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set turn_external_urls in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Call recording
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether a call's host may record it
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set call_recording_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Days a recording is kept
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Recordings are deleted this long after they start; 0 keeps them
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set call_recording_retention_days in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Live captions
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether someone in a call may turn captions on
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set call_captions_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SIP port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The UDP and TCP port for trunks and phones; empty with the TLS port keeps phone calls off
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set sip_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SIP address
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The address the SIP ports bind
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set sip_host in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SIP TLS port
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The TLS port for trunks and phones
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set sip_tls_port in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SIP public address
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The address trunks reach, when it is not the bound one
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set sip_public_address in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: Phone registrar
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: Whether desk and soft phones may register
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set sip_registrar_enabled in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.InstanceSetting.title: SIP domain
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.description: The domain phones register to
moqui.server.InstanceSetting.operatorNote: Set sip_domain in the environment or the runtime conf and restart

moqui.server.JobRegistration.title: Send produced system messages
moqui.server.JobRegistration.description: Sends the outgoing system messages that wait, and tries the failed ones again

moqui.server.JobParameterDefinition.title: Minutes before a failed message is sent again
Attempts before a message is failed for good

moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.title: Send produced system messages
moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.idempotencyNote: A run sends only messages that wait, and each is claimed by the send that takes it.

moqui.server.JobRegistration.title: Consume received system messages
moqui.server.JobRegistration.description: Consumes the received system messages that wait, and tries the failed ones again

moqui.server.JobParameterDefinition.title: Minutes before a failed message is consumed again
Attempts before a message is failed for good

moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.title: Consume received system messages
moqui.server.RecoveryDescriptor.idempotencyNote: A run consumes only messages that wait, and each is claimed by the consume that takes it.

moqui.server.JobRegistration.title: Clean the job run history
moqui.server.JobRegistration.description: Removes job runs older than the days kept

moqui.server.TopicRegistration.purpose: A job run ended with an error: sent to the job's recipients

moqui.server.TransferTarget.title: Message translations
moqui.server.TransferTarget.description: Translations of the messages people see, by original text and locale
moqui.server.TransferTarget.effectsNote: Each row saves one translation, replacing the one there; none is removed. The audit log keeps the text before and after.

moqui.server.TransferTarget.title: Message translations
moqui.server.TransferTarget.description: The translations of the messages people see, by original text and locale, as a file the import of translations reads

moqui.server.SettingsEntry.title: Instance settings
moqui.server.SettingsEntry.description: What the instance is called, its default locale and time zone, the new-device sign-in window, the group recipient ceiling, and where each deployment value comes from

moqui.server.SettingsEntry.title: Localization
moqui.server.SettingsEntry.description: Translations of messages and of the names of statuses, options, units and places

moqui.server.SettingsEntry.title: Connections
moqui.server.SettingsEntry.description: The remote systems, mail sign-in providers, printers and gateways this instance reaches, with their addresses and credentials

moqui.server.SettingsEntry.title: Mail relays
moqui.server.SettingsEntry.description: The outgoing mail servers the instance sends its own mail through

moqui.server.SettingsEntry.title: Mail and protocols
moqui.server.SettingsEntry.description: What the server speaks besides the web (mail reception, SSH and Git, chat, calls and phones), the configuration each runs with and the checks of it

moqui.server.SettingsEntry.title: Message types
moqui.server.SettingsEntry.description: The kinds of message exchanged with other systems: what sends and consumes each, among the handlers its owner registered, and its transport options

moqui.server.SettingsEntry.title: Notification topics
moqui.server.SettingsEntry.description: What people are notified about and how each topic is delivered when a person chose nothing, for the topics their owners registered
